findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'quickly' with a specific, measurable time limit (e.g., 'within 2 seconds').
Define measurable criteria for user-friendliness and intuitiveness (e.g., 'The system shall achieve a System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 80 or higher in user acceptance testing').
Define the specific duration of the standard timeout (e.g., 'Exported reports shall use a standard timeout of 15 minutes when generation takes too long').
Define the specific conditions or criteria that mandate account deactivation (e.g., 'Administrators shall be able to deactivate user accounts if the account has not been logged in for 90 days').

Define specific behaviors for error handling (e.g., 'The system shall display an error message to the user detailing the error code and suggest a resolution' or 'The system shall log all errors to the administrative console').

findings.evidence: using a link sent to their registered email address
findings.suggested_fix: Specify the validity period for the password reset link (e.g., 'using a link valid for 15 minutes').
Specify a definitive list of supported browsers (e.g., Chrome (latest 2 versions), Firefox (latest 2 versions), Safari (latest 2 versions), Edge (latest 2 versions)).

findings.evidence: calculate sales tax at checkout based on the shipping address
findings.suggested_fix: Specify the tax calculation logic, such as 'calculate sales tax using the current state/province tax rate database' or 'calculate sales tax at a rate of X%.'

findings.evidence: notify the user of the result
findings.suggested_fix: Specify the mechanism and content of the notification (e.g., 'notify the user via an on-screen message displaying the transaction ID and status').
Define a measurable metric or algorithm for 'relevance' (e.g., relevance score based on keyword match percentage, or a specific ranking algorithm).
Define a specific availability metric (e.g., 'The system shall maintain 99.99% uptime').
Specify the exact conditions or time limits under which cancellation is permitted (e.g., 'within 1 hour of order placement' or 'before the order status changes to Processing').
Define a specific time limit for the update (e.g., 'within 5 seconds' or 'immediately').
Specify the exact data protection regulations the system must comply with (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA).
Specify the exact behavior for handling failed payment attempts (e.g., 'The system shall display error code XXX and allow the user to retry the payment up to three times').
Define the target dimensions or scaling factor for the resized photos (e.g., 'resized to a maximum dimension of 500x500 pixels').
Specify the required encryption standard (e.g., AES-256) and algorithm to be used for sensitive data.
Define the acceptable data loss tolerance (e.g., 'The system shall ensure zero data loss during normal operation,' or specify recovery time objectives).
